2 HECTARES IN THE HEART OF TUNIS – A RARE OPPORTUNITY FOR DEVELOPERS & INVESTORS
For sale: an exceptional 20,000 m² (2-hectare) plot of land, ideally located in the heart of the capital, offering outstanding potential for the development of a high-end eco-tourism, sports and leisure project. The site could accommodate a unique concept combining charming cabins, guest houses, a restaurant, landscaped green spaces, a football field, padel courts and relaxation areas, creating a true urban oasis dedicated to nature, leisure and hospitality. A rare land investment opportunity for a developer or investor looking to create an innovative, distinctive and high-value project in Tunis. Contact us for the exact location, further information and a private viewing.
